in_hebrew.name: Frasco
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Little box, container
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Frasco הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Frasco is derived from the Latin word 'fraschus' which means 'little box' or 'container'. In the early Christian era, this name was given to infants born in a stable or manger. It symbolizes the cradle of life, signifying the humble beginnings and the promise of a prosperous future.
